changes.note: Fixed a bug with Portable Fusion Repeater that could result in hits failing to register.
Fixed a bug with Limit Break not correctly granting Overhealth for targets hit.
Fixed in a previous update - Resolved an issue that prevented Overhealth from being applied when Limit Break was activated.
Fixed a bug where Toggle Propulsors did not work on console platforms.
Fixed an issue with being damaged from the front with while Power Barrier was deployed.
Adjusted the height of the mech head hitbox to be more flush with the model.
Cast Time reduced from 0.15 to 0.05 seconds.
Cast Time reduced from 0.3 to 0.2 seconds.
Recovery Time reduced from 0.5 to 0.2 seconds.
Base movement speed reduced from 6 to 5.5 meters per second.
Self healing penalty increased from 25% to 40%.
